verdict.rationale: Anytype documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with its API through natural language. Its open-source agents skill lets tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot read, search and modify Objects and run bulk edits. Natural-language operation therefore works only through a third-party AI assistant, not natively in the app. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface, hands-on or independent corroboration that NL operation works reliably, and documentation of which product actions can be driven this way.
